verdict.rationale: Aider is a coding agent, so account-based free-tier sign-in is a fair axis for it, but the evidence documents no personal-account sign-in or vendor-provided free tier. Local models via Ollama and copy/pasting to a web chat interface do avoid API keys, but they are adjacent workarounds, not sign-in-based free access.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys
